items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He said pick one out and do a chart on it. I picked on out, did a chart on it.

ctx.x: He wasn't tall though, he was wide. Yeah. I heard that he was looking for charts and he was rehearsing in some studio and I went up to see him and he gave me a list of

tunes that he wanted in his book. He said pick one out and do a chart on it. I picked on out, did a chart on it. I don't remember what it was at all, but that was it, that was the first time I got paid for a job. I brought it in and he liked it.
Did you follow up and write more?
